svg.aria-label: juan@juanos exit. gg, thanks for stopping by. Off the clock: side projects, JuanOS and a lot of chess. Open chess.com/member/juanmallo. Under a starry night sky with a green and purple aurora, giant stone chess pieces wrapped in ivy, a king, a queen, a rook, pawns and a fallen knight's head, rest on a grassy plain with mossy rocks and fireflies.
